newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's king leaves hospital after knee treatment.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king leaves hospital after knee treatment.

text.p: King Hussein of Jordan left hospital on Sunday after successful treatment to a painful knee, state television said.
It said King Hussein, 61, resumed his normal schedule after a 24-hour stay in hospital during which he had a piece of cartilage removed from his left knee.
The king returned from a pilgrimage to Mecca on Friday.
